subject.title: [Feature]: Collapsible messages in Control UI chat

question: Should Control UI add inline collapse for long assistant Markdown, and what default threshold, latest-message behavior, and bulk-control policy should it use?
rationale: The missing behavior is a new UX policy rather than a broken current contract, and current main already has overlapping side-reader, JSON, tool, and duplicate-message disclosure patterns that should stay coherent.

options.title: Approve Bounded Inline Collapse
options.body: Implement a focused first version that collapses older long assistant Markdown by height or line threshold, keeps the active/latest response readable, and defers bulk controls unless maintainers want them now.

options.title: Use Existing Side Reader Only
options.body: Decline inline collapse for now and treat the canvas/sidebar reader as the supported long-message escape hatch, with a maintainer comment explaining that policy.

options.title: Defer To Broader Chat UX
options.body: Keep this open but wait for a broader chat readability/accessibility design before adding another disclosure state.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Inline Collapse
recommendation.body: Implement a focused first version that collapses older long assistant Markdown by height or line threshold, keeps the active/latest response readable, and defers bulk controls unless maintainers want them now.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available routing candidate from recent Control UI chat history and maintainer-side verification of the overlapping side-reader work.
